svg.title: Refurbished Marketplace architecture
svg.desc: Public edge, application services with catalog and checkout saga flows, Debezium and Kafka event backbone, GitOps delivery, and observability.

g.text: Runtime architecture / Talos dev + prod / Go services + event-driven checkout
Browse → Search / Meilisearch (no live stock); PDP → Products + Inventory stock read; Web also reads Orders + Payment status.
Saga: order → reserve stock → hosted session → payment result → commit or release stock → finalize order. Prices come from Products.
Uncertain payments stay under reconciliation; stock rejection never opens payment; a deadline worker drives timeouts + compensation.
talos-proxmox: shared operators + telemetry • this repo: marketplace app roots
Helm: External Secrets, MongoDB, Meilisearch, services, Strimzi Kafka
Apps emit OTLP traces + metrics, JSON logs → node agents.
Dev + prod forward to prod ClickStack; no public dashboard route.
